name: concord
description: Run a team of parallel AI coding agents on your repository, coordinated by Concord, and get one integrated branch.
long_description: Concord starts several coding agents (OpenCode or Claude Code) in parallel git worktrees on the current repository and coordinates them while they work: an agent is told when another agent changes a function signature it uses, and when it finishes, finished teammates' overlapping work is merged into its worktree so that it resolves the conflict itself. Tools: concord_run, concord_status, concord_result, concord_analyze, concord_cancel.

tools.name: concord_run
tools.description: Start a team of parallel coding agents on this repository, coordinated by Concord

tools.name: concord_status
tools.description: Progress of a Concord run, or the list of runs

tools.name: concord_result
tools.description: Final report and integration branch of a finished run

tools.name: concord_analyze
tools.description: Check existing branches for merge conflicts and broken function contracts
